caseName: Pointon v. Fidelity National Bank, N. A.
caseNameFull: Pointon, dba Sierra Pointon Fund, Inc. v. Fidelity National Bank, N. A.

opinions.text: Appeal from Ct. App. Okla. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
